generate_directory_preview: generate a textual preview of a directory including file tree structure and individual file previews
preview_csv_file: preview a CSV file showing row count, column count, and column statistics
preview_json_file: preview a JSON file by auto-generating and displaying its JSON schema
generate_file_tree: generate a tree structure of files in a directory with file size information
get_file_size: get the line count for text files or byte size for binary files with human-readable format
